_captured.where_the_urls_came_from: attributes.image_url on every offer row returned by the 16 category listing pages under https://cashkaro.com/products/home-categories-exclusive/<slug>. Same harvest as data/category-stores.json. Downloaded byte-for-byte with no re-encoding and no resizing.
_captured.filename_rule: Mechanical, from the site's own display name (attributes.name): lowercase, "&" becomes "and", every run of non-alphanumeric characters becomes a single "-", leading and trailing "-" trimmed. The extension is taken from the source URL, never from the name. Because the rule uses the site's display name and not a tidied brand name, some files carry the site's own suffixes: "Amazon India" gives amazon-india.jpg and "Flipkart CB Affoy" gives flipkart-cb-affoy.png. Use the aliases block below to resolve a clean brand name to a file.
_captured.collision_rule: If two display names reduce to the same filename, the first in alphabetical order by the site's unique_identifier keeps the derived name and the second falls back to its unique_identifier as the filename. Nothing is ever overwritten. Every occurrence is recorded in near_collisions below.
_captured.extension_caveat: The extension comes from the URL and the site does not always name its files after their real format. Where the header disagrees with the extension it is flagged extension_matches_format: false on that entry. The bytes are untouched either way - the file was NOT re-encoded and was NOT renamed, because renaming would break the stated rule that the extension comes from the URL.
_captured.dimensions_method: read from the file header (PNG IHDR, JPEG SOFn, GIF logical screen descriptor). No decode.
_captured.second_source: Three stores are on the homepage Most Popular Brands rail but in none of the 16 category listings: FirstCry, Acer and IGP. Their logo URLs were taken from the recommended_offers page element of the homepage __NEXT_DATA__ payload, the same capture and the same date. They carry categories: [] to say observed-absent, not not-checked.
